# ROPureOEM — ropureoem.com

> ROPureOEM is a water purifier OEM / ODM supplier for brand owners and distributors.
> Range: countertop RO purifiers, under-sink RO systems, water softeners, shower filters and faucet filters.
> Enquiries: Get a Quote at https://ropureoem.com/get-quote.html — tell us your target market and model of interest.
> Contact: ROPureOEM, info@ropureoem.com, WhatsApp +86 189 2882 3858.

## Buyer FAQ

**What is the minimum order quantity?** The first order is 200 units per model. Repeat orders are 500 units per model. Quantities from different models are counted separately. [MOQ guide](https://ropureoem.com/insights/water-purifier-oem-moq.html)

**How long does bulk production take?** The published lead time is 40 days after sample approval. [MOQ guide](https://ropureoem.com/insights/water-purifier-oem-moq.html)

**Which certifications are available?** Certificates are confirmed for the specific model, brand and target market before ordering. [Certification and testing support](https://ropureoem.com/certification.html)

**What are the shipping terms?** Prices are quoted FOB Shenzhen. Freight is confirmed separately per order. [MOQ guide](https://ropureoem.com/insights/water-purifier-oem-moq.html)

**How do I request a quote?** Send the model and target market through the quote form or contact info@ropureoem.com or WhatsApp +86 189 2882 3858. [Get a quote](https://ropureoem.com/get-quote.html)
